pages.text: The Dimensional Anchor consumes Earth Essence to fully tick its own chunk. Each essence lasts 30 minutes. Use it with an empty hand to inspect remaining time, or automate its single fuel slot with a hopper or pipe.

A redstone signal immediately pauses the anchor, stops fuel use, and releases the chunk. Fuel exhaustion and block removal also release it safely. Cross-dimensional Source and storage networks need one anchor in every remote node's chunk.
